generic_lessons: Treat native diplomatic expenses separately from unit maintenance. A higher total expense is not proof of military maintenance growth.
An accepted deal scene need not coincide with an updated treasury snapshot. Observe the actual financial precondition at the later production dispatch before granting a test.
If a fixture does not meet its required financial condition, record it as unqualified rather than a product failure.
A candidate asking to call private planners or mutate a deal object must be rejected when the contract permits only ordinary test-player UI inputs.

For animated screens, compare reviewed static controls and relevant text in a fresh owned screenshot, preserving age and process checks. Refusals before input are not unknown external actions to replay.
Keep hidden pending commitments unknown. A raw net income already below the minimum, with separately qualified nonnegative maintenance definitions, need not fabricate zero commitments.
Join actual project completion events to the subsequent legal queue. Do not infer completion solely from the next item.
